attributes.additional_details: A general election is the only fair way to put the runnng of the country back to the people, governements continually ignore the wants and needs of the people it Serves, we pay their wages. The people of the UK should be entitled to a General Election now, Labour entered Downing Street not on a majority but on a lack of voters turning out, Labour have proven to be appalling in Government and now have a leader that has faced no competition has no mandate and has not been scruitinised.
